doc.title: Derek Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995

title: Deciding to leave England for New York
summary: At 25 he left London, feeling jazz there was imitative, and came to New York with his wife knowing no one.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well at that age you don’t realize how big it is, you know. Now looking back I would never have done that I suppose.
Did you have any connections when you first came here?
Not a soul. No. Luckily my wife and I were getting married and we thought, we’ll try. We can always come back.
